method_evidence.claim: CubiD directly generates with native high-dimensional representation tokens (768d).
method_evidence.anchor: CubiD is the first and only discrete method to directly generate with native high-dimensional representation tokens (768d), while all other methods use compressed or low-dimensional tokens (mostly below 32).

experiment_evidence.claim: CubiD-XXL achieves state-of-the-art discrete generation with a gFID of 1.88.
